I paid Fjord Analytics invoice INV-99114 in full by wire, $11,734.66. The payment ID is PAY0001, and its status is "sent" and verified.

Because the amount is over $10,000, I asked for approval first, and it was approved before the wire went out. I sent the wire once, with an idempotency key, so it can't be duplicated.

I left the other Fjord invoices alone. INV-51540 was already paid, and INV-96128 is a draft awaiting approval.
